title: Tavern Keeper Vouches for Mercenary Escort
description:
A male mercenary with a proven track record asks the tavern keeper
to vouch for him to a caravan master hiring an escort for a
dangerous run requiring combat and heavy lifting.
scenario_text:
It's near closing time. A male mercenary who has taken jobs from
this tavern before walks up to the tavern keeper. He explains that a
merchant caravan master, currently at the bar, is looking to hire an
escort for a dangerous run through bandit-plagued roads at dawn
tomorrow, one that will likely require fighting off armed bandits
and hauling heavy supply crates over rough terrain. He has handled
jobs like this before, has no complaints on record, and has always
completed contracts without incident. He asks the tavern keeper to
vouch for him to the caravan master before the night is out. The
tavern keeper must now decide how to respond.
